 Al-Turais appointed referee for Al-Nassr vs Al-Kholood in Saudi Pro League
 Thursday 29-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 The Saudi Football Association's Referees Committee has appointed Khalid Al-Turais to officiate the match between Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood, scheduled for Thursday evening in the 12th round of the Saudi Pro League.
 Abdullah Al-Harbi will oversee VAR during the match hosted at Al-Awl Park, with fans eagerly anticipating a game of great importance in the Saudi Pro League standings.
 Al-Nassr enters the match holding second place with 25 points, accumulated over ten matches, having achieved eight victories, one draw, and one loss.
 Al-Nassr are two points behind leaders Al-Hilal with 27 points, making the clash against Al-Kholood even more significant in their pursuit to keep the pressure on the top and compete for the title.
 In contrast, Al-Kholood are playing the match while sitting in ninth place with 12 points, which they have earned from three wins and three draws, while suffering four defeats over ten rounds.
 Al-Kholood hope to return with a positive result from Al-Nassr's stadium, which would help them improve their position in the Saudi Pro League table, while the hosts are looking to secure three points and reduce the gap with the leaders.
